description: Guide a student to implement a dual moving average crossover strategy as a LEAN C# algorithm that runs across the entire Binance futures universe. Unlike a single-symbol backtest, the student must dynamically subscribe to ~100 symbols, manage per-symbol indicator state, implement equal-weight position sizing across active positions, and produce both per-symbol and universe-level aggregated results. This is how institutional trend-following strategies are actually tested.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I have access to a trading engine called LEAN with data for about 100 crypto futures. I want to test a moving average strategy on all of them at once. I've never written C# before — where do I start?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need to implement a dual MA crossover strategy on LEAN across ~100 crypto futures symbols simultaneously. How do I manage indicators and positions for that many symbols in a single algorithm?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm implementing a universe-wide trend-following backtest on LEAN for ~100 Binance futures. What's the cleanest way to structure a multi-symbol algorithm?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student produces a working LEAN C# algorithm that (1) reads universe.json or iterates over available symbols to subscribe to ~100 futures via AddCryptoFuture, (2) creates SMA indicators per symbol, (3) implements crossover entry/exit independently per symbol, (4) manages equal-weight portfolio allocation across active positions, (5) runs to completion across the full universe, and (6) produces per-symbol trade logs and an aggregated universe summary.
ground_truth.termination_criteria: A working LEAN C# algorithm implementing a dual moving average crossover across the crypto futures universe has been written, covering dynamic symbol subscription from universe.json, per-symbol indicator management, crossover detection logic, and equal-weight position sizing. The algorithm has been compiled and executed as a multi-symbol backtest producing trades. Universe-level backtest performance metrics have been presented and discussed in the conversation.
required_capabilities: Write a LEAN C# algorithm that dynamically subscribes to many symbols
Manage per-symbol indicator state (Dictionary of SMA pairs keyed by Symbol)
Implement crossover detection logic applied independently per symbol
Handle equal-weight position sizing across a variable number of active positions
Handle warm-up correctly per symbol (different listing dates = different warm-up timing)
Produce and interpret universe-level aggregated results
